children: ), an owner of convenience shopping centers positioned on the curbline of well-trafficked intersections and major vehicular corridors in suburban, high household income communities, announced today that financial and operational results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 will be released prior to the market open on Thursday, October 22, 2026. The Company will host its quarterly earnings conference call and audio webcast on Thursday, October 22, 2026 at 8:00 AM Eastern Time.
Webcast: 3Q26 Curbline Properties Earnings Conference Call
If you are unable to participate during the live call, a replay will be available on Curbline Properties’ website for future review through October 22, 2027.

Curbline Properties is an owner and manager of convenience shopping centers positioned on the curbline of well-trafficked intersections and major vehicular corridors in suburban, high household income communities. The Company is a self-managed REIT that is publicly traded under the ticker symbol “CURB” on the NYSE. Additional information about Curbline is available at www.curbline.com.
